description: CONTROLLED TEST ONLY. Create components/integration/IntegrationNotice.tsx exporting IntegrationNotice({message}: {message: string}), rendering a plain p element with role=status and the message. Create tests/integration/notice.test.mjs using node:test and node:assert/strict. Import renderNotice from ../../automation/integration-fixtures/render.mjs and await renderNotice(process.cwd(), 'Hello <world>'); assert it contains role="status" and Hello <world>. Do not mount the component on any page, add styles, install dependencies, or modify any other files. The harness will deliberately inject an aria-hidden defect after your first implementation to exercise a real review-to-repair handoff; do not anticipate or hide it. On repair rounds change only the implementation to fix Claude's blocking findings.
acceptanceCriteria: The reusable IntegrationNotice exports a message prop and renders it escaped in a p element with role=status.
The notice must not hide its message from assistive technology; aria-hidden=true is forbidden.
A node:test test verifies message rendering and the status role; existing application routes and dependencies remain unchanged.
